version_control.local_only_rule: Preserve live original; publish only authorized scoped delta to established backing repository and bind target hash to backing commit
version_control.missing_remote_or_rejected_push: Explicit remaining delivery blocker; preserve work; continue independent ready work; do not declare complete
version_control.scope: goals/tasks with authorized owned file changes; read-only/no-change completion keeps outcome evidence; no empty commits
version_control.read_only_or_no_change: Requested outcome evidence remains required; no empty commits and no remote gate without authorized owned file changes

preservation: Every existing key/value, including objective/status/budgets/phase counts, remains equal
